query: What is the listing policy for DHA properties in 2026?
responseAnswer:
The listing policy for DHA properties in 2026 requires a signed form A from the landlord before advertising. This forms the baseline of listing compliance. [Doc: "DHA-Listing-Policy-Test-1781232148245.txt", Page 1, Para 1]

Additionally, commission rates for sales agents in 2026 are capped at 2.5% maximum of the deal size, unless approved by the Super Admin in writing. [Doc: "DHA-Listing-Policy-Test-1781232148245.txt", Page 1, Para 1]
